ja383:1.1: Sucittapattacchadana lambacūlavihaṅgama oroha dumasākhāya, mudhā bhariyā bhavāmi te ti.
ja383:2.1: Catuppadā tvaṃ kalyāṇi, dipad' āhaṃ manorame, migī pakkhī asaññuttā, aññaṃ pariyesa sāmikan ti.
ja383:3.1: Komārikā te hessāmi mañjukā piyabhāṇinī, vinda maṃ ariyena vedena, sāvayā maṃ yad icchasīti.
ja383:4.1: Sakuṇakhādini lohitape cori kukkuṭapothini na tvaṃ ariyena vedena mamaṃ bhattāraṃ icchasīti.
ja383:5.1: Evam pi caturā nārī disvāna pavaraṃ naraṃ nenti saṇhāhi vācāhi biḷārī viya kukkuṭaṃ.
ja383:6.1: Yo ve uppatitaṃ atthaṃ na khippam anubujjhati (= supra p..) amittavasaṃ anveti pacchā ca-m-anutappati.
ja383:7.1: Yo ve uppatitaṃ atthaṃ khippam eva nibodhati muccate sattusambādhā kukkuṭo va biḷāriyā ti.
